prediction.question: 権兵衛はついに追憶市へ向かう決意を固めるが、そこで何を目にする？
options: 母の面影を持つ謎の商人
露店に集まる異様な行列
記憶を売るために並ぶ人々

en.title: The Evening Market of Edo Memories
en.premise: The 'Market of Recollections' is a mysterious stall that appears quietly only on festival nights, offering to buy the memories of those who visit. Gonbe, a poor but warm-hearted man living in a tenement house, sells a precious memory of his late mother to help a bedridden neighbor. The void left by his lost memory is filled by the boisterous yet heartwarming kindness of his neighbors.

zh.title: 江户追忆之宵市
zh.premise: 在祭典之夜悄然现身的，是一家收购记忆的神秘露店——“追忆市”。虽贫穷却内心富足的长屋男子权兵卫，为了卧病在床的邻居，卖掉了与亡母之间珍贵的回忆。而填补失去记忆之空洞的，则是长屋众人带来的喧闹却温暖的人情味。
